name: Physics-Informed Deep Learning Framework for Multi-Plane CGH
aliases: Multi-Plane Neural CGH with Physics-Informed Self-Supervision
definition: A deep learning framework that generates phase-only holograms for 3D multi-plane displays by learning a mapping from spatial intensity distributions to depth-dependent reconstructions, using a trainable Fourier transform layer and cosine similarity loss to suppress axial crosstalk.
summary: This framework generates phase-only holograms for multi-plane 3D targets by combining a specialized neural architecture with physics-informed self-supervision to reduce axial crosstalk and accelerate computation.
